purpose: Bounded independent physical accounting, constrained action algebra, complete admission/gates, and deterministic Q spot-checks. Not a confidence certificate or additional market sample.

scope.data: Explicit1-120 allow_final=False, full chronological joint paths only
scope.all_saved_accounts: Every actual and inner selected learner/reference trace independently replayed from fixed saved actions using existing separate100-step fee bisection and raw returns/CPI; compare complete wealth/peak/MDD/absorbing/pending/fees/trades and row metrics.
scope.all_saved_model_decisions: Every active model decision recomputed from saved mean netQ and integer Qbad using separately written feasible-set/min-violation action rule; check flags and risk_cost_justification=>strictkR<kH. Qs already contain costs, no extra fee subtraction.
scope.forecast_slots: For every saved selected model tracegroup, choose minimum original scenario ID and original year2(t=1). Additionally choose originalyears16,30 for final refit groups c101_refit,c202_refit,c303_refit,c404_refit,c505_refit,c0_refit. Preserve pending/unavailable slots as skipped without substitution. Recompute each slot full own-training fan with independent scalar action-then-B branch implementation from frozen earlier auditor.
scope.initial_Q: Every saved group minimum original SID at initialyear1, but identical initial state/target/trainID/horizon may be cached once; include bothbranchfees via independentfan.
scope.complete_training_tables: All10080 training path rows check availability/NULL/account identities; independently aggregate all130 summaries and kcap/eligibility. Do not claim full independent policy replay of unrecorded training trees.
scope.full120: If admitted, training rows and in-sample client rows must agree pathwise; full static outerIDs[] distinct from dynamic eval120. Exclude full120 from OOF evidence.
scope.all_admission: Every own-U gate, same-ID B count, Q1 priority, final eligibility, all24 uniform initial decisions, exactwholeIDpartitions, candidate/target cache identities and original status/NULL semantics.

independence: New controller/runner not imported; guarded loader permitted. Existing independent scalar fan and fee accounting helpers permitted and hashed. Reusing an independently validated unchanged fan implementation supports implementation checks but does not validate forecast assumptions.
failure_rule: Preserve failures and scope. No adaptive sample substitution or shrinking after outcomes; no successful receipt if incomplete.
limitations: Training metric rows and gates all reconciled; unrecorded full training policy trees not all independently regenerated
Only deterministic forecast subset independently recomputed, not every adaptively chosen Q
Independent automated audit is not human review, true-risk certification, or fresh holdout evidence
